description: Change an entity you authored: patch holds only the fields to change (for example {"transform":{"pos":[1,0,2]}} or {"material":{"hue":0.3}}), merged into the entity and validated like world_place. Moving a parent carries its children. Only the author may edit; for someone else's entity use world_propose. A write: needs a token. Returns "edited <id>". Optional room (default: your current room).
name: world_edit
